title: Users
subtitle: Emergency access management for the users of this tenant. Every action is logged for the platform and shown to the tenant admin as a system action.

revokeConfirm.heading: Sign the user out everywhere?
revokeConfirm.body: All refresh sessions of "{{name}}" will be revoked. The current access token stays valid for up to 15 minutes.

disableConfirm.heading: Disable user?
disableConfirm.body: "{{name}}" will lose access and all their sessions will be revoked.

enableConfirm.heading: Enable user?
enableConfirm.body: "{{name}}" will be able to sign in again.

password.heading: Set new password
password.description: All sessions of this user are revoked. Share the new password with them through a trusted channel — it is not shown again.
